messages:
elaine: Working on a staged evaluation plan for speculative decoding on the new quantized 70B candidate. Goal is to measure latency/throughput wins vs quality regressions, and to produce a go/no-go checklist for Dedicated bring-up.

elaine: High-level outline:
- small offline sweep to find safe spec params (spec_factor, lookahead, probe_prob)
- A/B quality comparisons across three eval suites (conversational, codegen, reasoning)
- cost model simulation (tokens saved * infra price)
- safety/degeneration checks and fail-open thresholds

mike: thx. can you add details on sample sizes + metrics?

elaine: sure. quick sketch:
- sample size: 2k prompts per suite for paired comparison (same seeds)
- metrics: P50/P95 latency, tok/sec, median tokens speculated, exact-match/ROUGE/MAUVE-ish for convs, pass@1 for code, accuracy for reasoning datasets
- statistical test: bootstrap paired diffs, report 95% CI and p-value

sasha: which model artifacts? q4 vs q8 vs float16? also how do we handle quant noise in quality comparisons?

elaine: plan to run on:
- llama3-70b-q4_0 (our quant build v1)
- llama3-70b-q8 (baseline quant)
- llama3-70b-fp16 (gold)
Compare spec on q4 vs q8, and spec off fp16 as upper bound. Use 5 deterministically seeded runs for codegen to control sampling variance.

elaine: quick config snippet we will use for the sweep:```yaml
speculation:
  enabled: true
  lookahead: 8             # tokens attempted by draft model
  probe_prob: 0.15         # prob of running draft check
  fallback_policy: strict  # immediate fallback on mismatch
  max_retries: 1
```

pranav: fallback_policy: strict is good for safety, but will amplify latency if mismatch rate high. can we add a throttled fallback option? e.g., allow optimistic accept for short responses (<64 tokens)

elaine: yes, add policy: optimistic_short_responses. will track mismatch_rate per bucket. acceptance criteria: if mismatch_rate < 2% overall and delta_quality >= -0.5% absolute on key metrics then accept. Also require >= 1.15x median tok/sec improvement.

mike: add cost simulation: cost_delta = (tokens_generated_saved * price_per_token) - extra infra cost (retries). want estimated monthly savings for a 100 req/s workload.

elaine: good call. I'll output a small table in the experiment summary.

sasha: what about eval harness? do we instrument logits to detect hallucinations / divergence?

elaine: we'll record draft vs final tokens and token-level agreement. also run a toxicity + factuality probe (truthfulQA subset + simple fact-checker). If hallucination increases > 1.0% on critical probes -> fail.

pranav: CI integration: can ci-bot schedule the sweep on dedicated dev pool and post results artifact link?

ci-bot: scheduled job id run-2026-08-22-09 on pool dev-spec-1, will post artifact to s3://redwood-evals/spec-run-1837654321/ once done :white_check_mark:

mike: timeline? rough ETA?

elaine: sweep starts tomorrow morning; quick pass should finish within 6 hours on dev pool. then 24h for deeper runs and cost sim. aiming for a short memo by Fri EOD with go/no-go recommendation.

sasha: please include a short reproducibility checklist in the memo (seed list, dataset snapshot ids, model sha, quant recipe).

elaine: yep. will include:
- datasets: conv-v1 (sha: d3f7a), codeeval-cc (sha: a7c1b), reason-suite (sha: b220f)
- seeds: [42, 99, 123, 2026, 31415]
- model shas: q4_v1: sha_0a1b, q8_baseline: sha_f3e2, fp16_gold: sha_c9d8
- bench command: `python eval/run_speculative.py --model {model} --spec-config cfg.yaml --prompts prompts.jsonl --out results.jsonl`

mike: cool. lmk when you have the memo, i'll review the stop criteria.

elaine: will do. tagging @sasha @pranav for visibility. :thumbsup:
